messages.content: Explain to a Python beginner why 0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3 is false. Give three short paragraphs and one runnable Python example. Cover representation error, math.isclose, and when Decimal is appropriate. Your final answer should teach the idea, not just name the functions.

Teach binary search using [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13] and target 11. In the final answer, show each tested midpoint, state the loop invariant, explain why the interval shrinks, and give time and space complexity. Include a correct Python function returning the index or -1.

Write a professional email of 100-140 words to Alex asking to move our project review from Tuesday to Thursday. Facts: two test failures remain; the fix is written but not yet verified; I can send test results Wednesday afternoon. Keep accountability, avoid claiming tests passed, and do not invent reasons or promises beyond these facts.

Use only these facts to write a clear plan with an explanation of each dependency: a release needs tests passing, a successful staging deployment, and a healthy staging check. Tests are still running. Staging must use the exact tested commit. Production deployment is not yet approved. Cover what to do now, what follows success, what to do on failure, and where to stop. Include a short final checklist; do not claim any step already succeeded.
